title: Scored Script
description: Structured script format with inline visual-narration bindings. Every segment declares its own visual, creating an unbreakable 1:1 binding. Replaces freeform markdown showrunner scripts.

act.description: Act ID this segment belongs to (e.g. act_1)

narration.description: Pure narration text. No markers, no brackets. Only speakable words.

silence_after_s.description: Seconds of silence/black to insert after this segment

editorial_intent.description: Editorial purpose of this segment — drives pacing and tone

pacing.description: Pacing type for cut timing and hold duration

description.description: Rich prose description of the visual. Must match the narration content.

type.description: Visual asset type — determines generation routing. 'ai_video' = AI-generated (primary source); footage types are stock/archival fallback.

card_type.description: Required when type is text_card. Determines visual template.

template.description: Manim template name (e.g. dose_chart, race_condition, state_machine)

must_show.description: Required visual elements that must appear in the render

animation_phases.description: Animation phases with relative timing (pcts must sum to 100)

location_id.description: Semantic location key for unique_per_location dedup

subject_continuity.description: Segment ID this visual should feel continuous with

reference_images.description: Paths to reference images for accuracy checking

search_queries.description: Tiered search queries for footage sourcing

ai_fallback_prompt.description: Prompt for AI video generation if stock footage unavailable

ai_prompt.description: Primary subject/scene prose for AI video generation (used when type is ai_video). Falls back to 'description' if absent.

ai_motion.description: Camera/subject motion for AI video, e.g. 'slow dolly in, static subject'. Maps to shot_prompt_builder camera_movement.

ai_style.description: Look/era/grade for AI video, e.g. '1985 documentary, 16mm grain, muted institutional palette'.

ai_reference_image.description: Path to a per-shot keyframe image used as the image-to-video anchor. Usually derived from asset_ref's canonical_reference_image.

asset_ref.description: Foreign key into the Asset Bible (asset_id). Threads canonical visual identity through every shot of this location/subject.

shots.description: Optional explicit shot breakdown for long segments. If absent, the video seam auto-splits the segment by max shot length.

duration_weight.description: Relative share of the segment's target duration. Weights are normalized across shots.

hero.description: Escalate this shot to a premium provider (Kie.ai veo3/runway).

values.description: Key-value data for stat_reveal or other data-driven cards

emphasis.description: Which value to visually emphasize in a stat_reveal

terminal_text.description: Primary text for error_message card type

subtext.description: Secondary text below the main terminal_text

state.description: Music state transition at this segment
